claims.text: Idarucizumab: 5 g IV, given as two 2.5 g/50 mL vials.
claims.quote: The recommended dose of PRAXBIND is 5 g, provided as two separate vials each containing 2.5 g/50 mL idarucizumab

claims.text: PCC (Kcentra) for warfarin reversal: dose by baseline INR and body weight;
claims.quote: KCENTRA dosing should be individualized based on the patient's baseline International Normalized Ratio (INR) value, and body weight.

claims.text: give vitamin K concurrently to keep factor levels up once PCC wears off.
claims.quote: Administer Vitamin K concurrently to patients receiving KCENTRA to maintain factor levels once the effects of KCENTRA have diminished.

claims.text: Kcentra boxed warning: fatal and non-fatal arterial and venous thromboembolic complications;
claims.quote: Both fatal and non-fatal arterial and venous thromboembolic complications have been reported with KCENTRA
claims.locator: Boxed Warning: Arterial and Venous Thromboembolic Complications

claims.text: may not be suitable after a thromboembolic event in the prior 3 months.
claims.quote: KCENTRA may not be suitable in patients with thromboembolic events in the prior 3 months.
claims.locator: Boxed Warning: Arterial and Venous Thromboembolic Complications

claims.text: Vitamin K (anticoagulant-induced hypoprothrombinemia): 2.5–10 mg or more SC, IM or IV, up to 25–50 mg as a single dose;
claims.quote: Anticoagulant-Induced Hypoprothrombinemia: Vitamin K 1 Injection 2.5 mg to 10 mg or more subcutaneously, intramuscularly, or intravenously. Up to 25 mg to 50 mg may be administered as a single dose.
claims.locator: 2.2 Recommended Dosage for Coagulation Disorders from Vitamin K Deficiency or Interference

claims.text: when IV can't be avoided, inject very slowly, ≤ 1 mg/min.
claims.quote: When intravenous administration is unavoidable, inject the drug very slowly, not exceeding 1 mg per minute.

claims.text: Vitamin K boxed warning: fatal hypersensitivity reactions incl. anaphylaxis with IV and IM injection,
claims.quote: Fatal hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis, have occurred during and immediately after intravenous and intramuscular injection of Vitamin K 1 Injection.
claims.locator: Boxed Warning: Hypersensitivity Reactions with Intravenous and Intramuscular Use

claims.text: even after dilution and on the first dose;
claims.quote: Reactions have occurred despite dilution to avoid rapid intravenous infusion and upon first dose.
claims.locator: Boxed Warning: Hypersensitivity Reactions with Intravenous and Intramuscular Use

claims.text: avoid IV/IM unless SC isn't feasible and the serious risk is justified.
claims.quote: Avoid the intravenous and intramuscular routes of administration unless the subcutaneous route is not feasible and the serious risk is justified
claims.locator: Boxed Warning: Hypersensitivity Reactions with Intravenous and Intramuscular Use
